content.title: 2 Software Stocks Worth Investigating and 1 We Turn Down
content.summary: Software is eating the world, and virtually no business is left untouched by it. Companies bringing it to life have been rewarded with high valuation multiples that make fundraising easier, but they have weighed on the returns lately as the industry has pulled back by 1.9% over the past six months. This drawdown is a noticeable divergence from the S&P 500’s 13.1% return.
